history.name: A misfiled entry is caught as it is written
history.description: Filing a feature into an area or a sub-section that doesn't exist is refused straight away, with the real ones listed. A mistyped area is found while the entry is being written rather than three features later, and a sub-section can't be filled from an area it doesn't belong to.
history.dev_notes: cmdAdd checks both against config.categories and subcategories before writing; FeatureSet#validate re-checks at load for anything hand-edited.
